name: trace_one
statement: trace R M 1 = (finrank R M : R)

name: trace_id
statement: trace R M id = (finrank R M : R)

name: trace_prodMap
statement: trace R (M × N) ∘ₗ prodMapLinear R M N M N R = (coprod id id : R × R →ₗ[R] R) ∘ₗ prodMap (trace R M) (trace R N)

name: trace_prodMap'
statement: M →ₗ[R] M) (g : N →ₗ[R] N) : trace R (M × N) (prodMap f g) = trace R M f + trace R N g

name: trace_tensorProduct'
statement: M →ₗ[R] M) (g : N →ₗ[R] N) : trace R (M ⊗ N) (map f g) = trace R M f * trace R N g

have_tree.name: h
have_tree.body: LinearMap.ext_iff.1 (LinearMap.ext_iff.1 (trace_tensorProduct R M N) f) g

name: trace_comp_comm'
statement: M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] M) : trace R M (g ∘ₗ f) = trace R N (f ∘ₗ g)

have_tree.name: h
have_tree.body: LinearMap.ext_iff.1 (LinearMap.ext_iff.1 (trace_comp_comm R M N) g) f

name: Module.Free.bijective_algebraMap_of_finrank_eq_one
statement: Type*} [CommRing R] [Ring S] [Algebra R S] [Nontrivial R] [Free R S] (h : finrank R S = 1) : Function.Bijective (algebraMap R S)
